head_commit.message:
fix(exec): clean up post-rebase merge leftovers

Remove duplicated test coverage and restore the missing `tokio::time`
imports and active `thread_id` binding in `exec/src/lib.rs` after the
upstream rebase.

This keeps the rebased branch in a runnable state instead of relying on
local uncommitted fixes discovered during post-rebase verification.
